findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_yield_durability · Private data: get_yield_signal, get_shared_exposure · Public sink: get_yield_durability, get_exit_capacity · Destructive: get_yield_decision.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_yield_durability · Private data: get_yield_signal, get_shared_exposure · Public sink: get_yield_durability, get_exit_capacity · Destructive: get_yield_decision

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
